parts.name: garment
parts.keep: the whole weathered studded leather coat with its ragged fur trim, from the shoulders down to its torn hem, the wide belt with its buckle, the sheaths at its sides, as a garment on its own: no body, no head, no arms, no hands, no legs, the garment hollow inside where the body was, seen straight from the front
